old_caption:
The video showcases a serene aquatic scene, likely a pond or shallow lake, with clear water that allows visibility of the submerged vegetation at the bottom. The water surface is calm, with gentle ripples indicating a slight breeze or movement. Several thin, vertical stems protrude from the water, some appearing to be reeds or similar aquatic plants. These stems vary in height and thickness, creating a natural and organic arrangement. The water's clarity reveals the sandy or muddy bottom, scattered with leaves and other organic debris, suggesting a natural, undisturbed environment.

In the background, faint ripples spread across the water, adding a dynamic element to the otherwise tranquil setting. The lighting appears soft, possibly due to overcast skies or the time of day, which enhances the peaceful ambiance of the scene. The overall atmosphere is one of quiet beauty, emphasizing the simplicity and naturalness of the aquatic habitat. There are no visible animals or human characters in the frame, focusing entirely on the natural elements of the environment

caption: The video showcases a calm, murky lake surface viewed from above, where dead leaves and debris lie suspended beneath the water. Several thin reed blades protrude from the surface, including a tall near-vertical blade with a small brown node at the centre and a splayed cluster of blades in the lower-centre. A few short angled blades sit on the right, and a thin dark stroke marks the upper-left edge beside the channel logo. Throughout the excerpt this upper-left stroke lengthens downward, transforming from a short straight diagonal into a longer wavy, zigzag vertical mark before straightening again toward a diagonal. In the latter portion of the clip, faint concentric ripples emerge near the top-centre of the water. They expand outward as additional rings, while the cause of these surface disturbances remains outside the visible frame. The protruding reeds, the submerged leaves, and the overall framing hold essentially fixed positions, with no detectable camera translation or pan. Static text and logo overlays sit in the top-left and bottom-right corners, and Chinese location text marks the scene as a lake in New Taipei, Taiwan.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
